blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Mid Meadows fell from 10 in June to 9 in September, and 7 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 24.3% of Pitt Meadows’s 37 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Mid Meadows?
Mid Meadows also had 12 condos and townhomes listed and 4 sold in September, against 9 houses listed. The Mid Meadows condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Mid Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 houses listed in Mid Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mid Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Mid Meadows had a sales ratio of 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Mid Meadows from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Mid Meadows over those 4 months, out of 37 in all of Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Mid Meadows?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
